regions.introTitleHtml: RS DigitalEdge™ is the unified payment modernization platform
regions.introHtml:
Payments are evolving at remarkable speed, connecting customers, banks, merchants, and payment rails like never before. Banks and financial institutions need the flexibility to support real-time, card, account-based, and emerging payment flows all through infrastructure that can keep pace.

RS DigitalEdge™ brings these moving parts together through a single intelligent orchestration layer, combining smart routing, real-time decisioning, message transformation, compliance, and resilience. Its API-first, cloud-ready architecture helps institutions modernize payment capabilities while extending existing systems rather than replacing them.

metrics.descHtml: Accelerate the adoption of new payment schemes and overlay services.
Optimize payment flows through intelligent channel and network selection.

regions.whyTitleHtml: RS DigitalEdge™ orchestrates payments across rails, systems and business flows
regions.whyHtml:
Modern payment infrastructure cannot afford to operate as a collection of disconnected rails. DigitalEdge creates a unified orchestration layer that connects payment networks, transforms messages, applies business rules, and intelligently routes transactions while working alongside existing payment and core systems.

Its composable architecture allows institutions to modernize progressively, adding capabilities as their payment needs evolve.

caps.descHtml: Orchestrate payment flows across real-time, card, account-based, and alternate payment networks through a unified platform.
Use AI insights and configurable business rules to determine the right payment path, improving transaction success and optimizing processing costs.
Connect payment rails, core systems, ERP platforms, and fraud/risk systems through a streamlined API layer.
Native ISO 20022 readiness with built-in adapters for ISO 8583 and native message formats.
Build and modify payment workflows with low-code configurability, reducing engineering dependency and accelerating change.
Core, Mantle and Surface layers allow institutions to introduce capabilities incrementally without disrupting existing systems.
Automated retries, failover and exception handling help keep payment flows running through operational disruptions.
Live telemetry, reporting and transaction lineage provide visibility into how payment flows perform, fail and recover.

regions.introTitleHtml: RS DigitalEdge™ orchestrating India's next phase of digital payments
regions.introHtml:
India's payment ecosystem has demonstrated what happens when digital payments are built for scale. The next challenge is connecting that scale across rails, institutions and emerging payment use cases.

RS DigitalEdge™ provides the orchestration layer to connect UPI, IMPS, NEFT, RTGS and other payment flows through a unified architecture. With API-first integration, intelligent routing and ISO 20022 readiness, it helps institutions modernize without replacing the systems already powering their payment operations.

metrics.descHtml: Accelerate adoption of new payment capabilities and payment schemes.
Optimize routing and channel selection across payment flows.
Designed for resilient, continuous payment operations.

regions.whyTitleHtml: Built for a payment ecosystem that moves at India's speed
regions.whyHtml:
India's payment landscape spans high-volume digital payments, traditional banking rails and increasingly connected cross-border corridors. DigitalEdge brings these flows together through one orchestration layer, helping institutions connect existing infrastructure with new payment capabilities.

From UPI, IMPS, NEFT and RTGS to cross-border corridors such as UPI–PayNow, the platform provides the connectivity, transformation and routing capabilities needed to move between payment environments without creating another layer of fragmentation.

caps.descHtml: Connect and orchestrate payment flows across UPI, IMPS, NEFT, RTGS and other payment environments.
Apply configurable business rules and real-time intelligence to select the appropriate payment path.
Expose payment capabilities through APIs and integrate with existing banking and enterprise systems.
Support ISO 20022 adoption while maintaining interoperability with existing message formats.
Support payment corridor connectivity such as UPI–PayNow and other emerging cross-border flows.
Create and adapt payment workflows faster without extensive engineering changes.
Automate retries, exception handling and failover to maintain continuity across payment journeys.
Track payment events, transaction states and processing performance through reporting and telemetry.

regions.introTitleHtml: RS DigitalEdge™ connecting Canada's evolving payment landscape
regions.introHtml:
Canada's payment modernization journey brings together new real-time capabilities, established payment infrastructure and growing demand for cross-border interoperability.

RS DigitalEdge™ creates a unified orchestration layer across RTR, ACH and connected payment environments, helping financial institutions modernize without disrupting existing infrastructure. With ISO 20022 readiness, intelligent routing and real-time orchestration, institutions can connect domestic and cross-border payment flows through a common architecture.

metrics.descHtml: Accelerate readiness for evolving payment schemes and payment services.
Support resilient payment operations across connected rails.

regions.whyTitleHtml: From RTR readiness to cross-border connectivity, one orchestration layer
regions.whyHtml:
Modernization becomes more complex when institutions have to operate new real-time capabilities alongside existing payment infrastructure.

RS DigitalEdge™ brings these environments together. It can orchestrate RTR, ACH, and FedNow-connected flows, while providing visibility across payment processing, routing, liquidity, and exceptions.

For institutions expanding beyond domestic payments, its ISO 20022-ready architecture also creates a foundation for interoperability across CAD/USD corridors and other cross-border payment flows.

caps.descHtml: Connect and orchestrate RTR alongside existing payment environments through a unified layer.
Apply configurable routing rules to optimize payment paths based on business requirements.
Support connected corridors such as RTR–FedNow and other cross-border payment flows.
Transform, validate and enrich messages while maintaining interoperability with existing formats.
Connect payment infrastructure, core banking, ERP and other enterprise systems through APIs.
Provide visibility into payment flows, funding positions and operational performance.
Manage retries, exceptions and failover across payment journeys.
Add new capabilities progressively without a disruptive rip-and-replace transformation.

regions.introTitleHtml: RS DigitalEdge™ orchestrating America's move to real-time payments
regions.introHtml:
The U.S. payment landscape is moving across ACH, cards, FedNow, RTP and emerging real-time payment use cases, creating a growing need to connect different payment environments without adding more operational complexity.

RS DigitalEdge™ provides a unified orchestration layer across these rails, combining intelligent routing, ISO 20022 message transformation, API-first connectivity and real-time exception handling. Institutions can modernize payment capabilities while continuing to work with their existing core and payment infrastructure.

metrics.descHtml: Accelerate adoption of new payment schemes and overlay capabilities.
Optimize payment routing and channel selection.
Support resilient payment operations across always-on payment environments.

regions.whyTitleHtml: From ACH and cards to FedNow and RTP, connect the payment landscape
regions.whyHtml:
U.S. institutions increasingly need to manage traditional and real-time payment environments side by side. DigitalEdge creates a common orchestration layer that connects these flows rather than forcing each rail to operate as another isolated integration.

With FedNow, RTP, ACH, cards and SWIFT MX within the modernization landscape, DigitalEdge supports message transformation, intelligent routing, exception handling and ISO 20022 interoperability through a unified architecture.

caps.descHtml: Connect and orchestrate real-time payment flows alongside existing payment environments.
Bring ACH, RTP, FedNow, cards and other payment flows into a unified orchestration layer.
Use configurable rules and real-time intelligence to select efficient payment paths.
Support ISO 20022-based payment modernization while maintaining interoperability with existing formats.
Connect payment switches, core systems, ERP platforms and fraud/risk systems through APIs.
Support capabilities such as Request-to-Pay, Confirmation of Payee and other payment overlays.
Automated retries, failover and exception handling help maintain continuity across payment flows.
Provide visibility into payment flows, liquidity positions and orchestration performance.

regions.introTitleHtml: RS DigitalEdge™ one orchestration layer for a connected Nordic payment landscape
regions.introHtml:
The Nordic payments landscape is increasingly shaped by instant payments, account-to-account flows, common standards and cross-border interoperability.

RS DigitalEdge™ helps institutions bring these payment environments together through a single orchestration layer. Its API-first, ISO 20022-ready architecture supports payment routing, message transformation and interoperability across evolving instant-payment ecosystems while allowing existing infrastructure to remain in place.

metrics.descHtml: Accelerate adoption of evolving payment schemes and payment capabilities.
Optimize payment routing and channel selection.
Support resilient payment processing across connected payment environments.

regions.whyTitleHtml: Orchestrating the move toward connected, instant payments
regions.whyHtml:
As payment ecosystems converge around SEPA, instant payments and emerging real-time infrastructures, interoperability becomes as important as transaction speed.

DigitalEdge provides a common orchestration layer for these environments, helping institutions connect payment flows, apply routing logic and manage ISO 20022 messages without rebuilding their underlying systems.

Its composable architecture also supports a more gradual modernization path—allowing new payment capabilities to be introduced as market requirements evolve.

caps.descHtml: Manage payment flows across instant and account-based payment environments through one orchestration layer.
Connect real-time, card, account-based and alternative payment flows without creating isolated integrations.
Use configurable rules and real-time intelligence to select appropriate payment paths.
Support ISO 20022-based payment environments while maintaining connectivity with existing message formats.
Support interoperability across domestic and international payment corridors.
Configure and adapt payment processes with reduced engineering dependency.
Automated retries, exception management and failover help maintain continuity across payment flows.
Monitor payment journeys, transaction states and orchestration performance through live operational data.
